events.title: Tiffany Ng, carillon
events.summary: Enjoy a 30-minute carillon recital performed by University Carillonist Tiffany Ng on the Charles Baird Carillon. This unique musical experience features an instrument with 53 bronze bells, offering a chance to hear the resonant tones of this historic tower.

evidence.description: University Carillonist Tiffany Ng performs on the Charles Baird Carillon, an instrument of 53 bronze bells located inside the Burton Memorial Tower.

events.title: The Ark’s Open Stage
events.summary: Musicians can take the stage for eight minutes or two songs at The Ark's Open Stage night. It's a chance to perform live in a supportive environment, with tickets available at the door.
events.registration: Tickets available at the door only.

evidence.description: Whether you’re looking for your big break, want to perfect your live performance skills, or just want to perform live for the sheer fun of it, Open Stage nights offer supportive audiences and a terrific space. Performers have eight minutes (or two songs) each to do their thing. Doors open at 7:30, and names are drawn at 7:55 and 8:30. If your name isn’t chosen, bring your raffle ticket with you next time, and you’ll double your chances.
evidence.registration: No advance tickets. Tickets available at the door only.

events.title: Learning Seminar in Algebraic Combinatorics
events.summary: Attend a seminar on algebraic combinatorics exploring torus-equivariant cohomology classes of smooth projective varieties. The session will delve into the 6-vertex model and its relation to Schubert classes and R-matrices for flag varieties.

evidence.description: Torus-equivariant cohomology classes of smooth projective varieties (e.g. flag varieties) are determined by their restrictions to fixed points. We'll compute these for Schubert classes in type A, using the 5-vertex model and colored extensions. The 6-vertex will be about the "Chern-Schwartz-MacPherson" deformations of Schubert classes. Then we'll introduce a trivalent analogue of R-matrices and use it to compute the products of Schubert classes, for up to 4-step flag varieties.
